item.title: Meet Horizon UI · The AI Assistant: Ask Your Observability Data in Plain Language
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Horizon UI's new AI Assistant answers questions about your live system with the same charts, topology and tables as the UI — read-only, permission-scoped, and running on a cost-efficient model you bring yourself.

item.title: 认识 Horizon UI · AI Assistant：用日常语言查询你的可观测性数据
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: Horizon UI 新增的 AI Assistant 可以用和 UI 相同的图表、拓扑和表格回答运行中系统的问题；它只读、按权限返回结果，并运行在你自己接入的高性价比模型上。

item.title: Monitoring LLM Applications with SkyWalking 10.4: Insights into Performance and Cost
item.dc:creator: YiMing Shao
item.description: SkyWalking 10.4 introduces the Virtual GenAI dashboard. This article explores how to use this new feature to monitor and optimize LLM integrations.

item.title: 基于 SkyWalking 10.4 的大模型应用监控：洞察 LLM 的性能与成本
item.dc:creator: 邵一鸣
item.description: SkyWalking 10.4 增加了 Virtual GenAI 观测面板,本文将介绍该新特性的使用。

item.title: Monitoring Envoy AI Gateway with Apache SkyWalking
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: Set up full-stack observability for your AI/LLM traffic using Envoy AI Gateway, SkyWalking OAP 10.4.0, and BanyanDB 0.10.0.

item.title: 用 Apache SkyWalking 监控 Envoy AI Gateway
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: 基于 Envoy AI Gateway、SkyWalking OAP 10.4.0 和 BanyanDB 0.10.0，搭建面向 AI/LLM 流量的全栈可观测方案。

item.title: AI Coding 如何重塑软件架构师的工作方式
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: 以 SkyWalking GraalVM Distro 为例，聊聊 AI Coding 如何让更好的架构方案更容易被验证、打磨并真正落地。

item.title: How AI Changed the Economics of Architecture
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: A case study in how AI changed the economics of architecture in a mature project by making better designs cheaper to prototype, validate, and refine.

item.title: Agentic Vibe Coding in a Mature OSS Project: What Worked, What Didn't
item.dc:creator: Sheng Wu
item.description: What happens when you apply agentic AI coding to a mature open-source project with real users, real compatibility contracts, and real consequences? 77K lines changed in 5 weeks — here's what I learned.

item.title: 在成熟开源大型项目中实践 Agentic Vibe Coding：软件工程与工程控制论还在延续
item.dc:creator: 吴晟
item.description: 当你把 AI 智能体编程应用到一个有真实用户、广泛运用、API 被充分集成的成熟开源项目时，我在 5 周改了 7.7 万行代码，里面到底用到了哪些方法？这是我的实战总结。
